items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: Captain Pritchett was at the head of WWL at that time.

ctx.x: Hmm, that's something, Coast to Coast. Yeah, Coast to Coast, yeah. I don't know, I lost those records.

I wanted to always keep them, you know, before the clips, you see. Oh, you had records? I had records of it from the station, Captain Pritchett was at the head of WWL at that time. Anybody know him, Captain Pritchett? No, I haven't. He was on Tulane, I mean, yeah, Tulane. You remember the school up there?
That's where I work at Tulane.
